methods.name: direct_pair_proportional
methods.label: Direct pair inference + proportional demos
methods.description: Calibrate pair overlaps, infer higher orders, then scale VID demographics proportionally.

methods.name: mixture_pair_proportional
methods.label: Mixture pair inference + proportional demos
methods.description: Use the matchability mixture for pair capture, infer higher orders, then scale demographics.

methods.name: provider_email_proportional
methods.label: Provider email-first total + proportional demos
methods.description: Panel-trained total model using email-derived VID overlap without campaign context.

methods.name: provider_context_proportional
methods.label: Provider total with context + proportional demos
methods.description: Panel-trained total model adds objective and audience-strategy inputs.

methods.name: provider_context_fixed_demo
methods.label: Provider total + fixed panel demo adjustment
methods.description: Uses one panel-learned correction per demographic cell.

methods.name: provider_context_learned_demo
methods.label: Provider total + contextual panel demo adjustment
methods.description: Adjusts VID demographic shares using panel and campaign context.

methods.name: oracle_total_proportional
methods.label: Oracle total + proportional demos
methods.description: Uses true synthetic total to isolate proportional allocation error.

methods.name: oracle_total_learned_demo
methods.label: Oracle total + contextual panel demos
methods.description: Uses true synthetic total to isolate the remaining demographic-allocation error.
